_comment: Full output for references/sample_input.json. Quantitative sections (input_quality, taxable_gain_loss_snapshot, all flag arrays, professional_review_flags, downstream_handoff) are produced verbatim by scripts/tax_flags.py. Qualitative sections (tax_considerations_summary, account_tax_treatment_review, asset_location_observations, withdrawal_tax_flags, adviser_review_questions) are added by the model.

tax_considerations_summary.summary_text: The taxable brokerage account contains a highly concentrated, low-basis single-stock position (ACME Corp) with an embedded gain of $260,000 (86.7% of market value, 17.9% of total portfolio). A loss position in VXUS (-$15,000) may be a candidate for tax-loss review. One holding (XYZ Growth Fund) is missing cost basis, limiting analysis. The Traditional IRA ($600,000) creates a Roth conversion planning discussion window given 11 years before RMD age and anticipated retirement. Charitable intent is noted but QCD eligibility has not been reached (age 62 < 70). California state income tax applies to all taxable income events. All items below are considerations for CPA/adviser review — not advice or transaction instructions.

Professional review is required before any withdrawal strategy is implemented.
